title: Light-dependent flavin redox and adduct states control the conformation and DNA binding activity of the transcription factor EL222
authors: Aditya S. Chaudhari; Adrien Favier; Zahra Aliakbar Tehrani; Tomáš Kovaľ; Inger Andersson; Bohdan Schneider; Jan Dohnálek; Jiří Černý; Bernhard Brutscher; Gustavo Fuertes
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD/metadynamics模拟结合多种实验手段，系统研究光控转录因子EL222的FMN氧化还原态与加合物形成如何调控其构象动态、寡聚化及DNA结合活性，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法上采用物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The activity of the transcription factor EL222 is regulated through protein-chromophore adduct formation, interdomain dynamics, oligomerization and protein-DNA interactions, all triggered by photo-excitation of its flavin mononucleotide (FMN) cofactor. To gain molecular-level insight into the photocycle of EL222, we applied complementary methods: macromolecular X-ray crystallography (MX), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, optical spectroscopies (infrared and UV/visible), molecular dynamics/metadynamics (MD/metaD) simulations, and protein engineering using non-canonical amino acids. The observation of only subtle atomic displacements between crystal structures of EL222 with and without blue-light back-illumination, was confirmed by NMR data indicating no major changes in secondary structure and fold compactness. Kinetic experiments in solution provided evidence for two distinct EL222 conformations (lit1 and lit2) that become sequentially populated under illumination. These two lit states were assigned to covalently-bound N 5 protonated, and non-covalently-bound hydroquinone forms of FMN, respectively. Molecular modeling revealed differential dynamics and domain separation times arising from the three FMN states (oxidized, adduct, and reduced). Furthermore, while the dark state is largely monomeric, both lit states undergo slow monomer-dimer exchange. The photoinduced loss of α-helicity, seen by infrared difference spectroscopy, was ascribed to dimeric EL222 species. Unexpectedly, NMR revealed that all three EL222 species (dark, lit1, lit2) can associate with DNA to some extent, but only under illumination a high population of stable complexes is obtained. Overall, we propose a refined model of EL222 photo-activation where photoinduced changes in the oxidation state of FMN and thioadduct formation shift the population equilibrium towards an open conformation that favors self-association and DNA-binding. Significance Statement Flavin-binding light-oxygen-voltage (LOV) proteins constitute a prominent example of highly evolved chromophore-containing proteins that convert light into biochemical changes in the cell. However, it is not well understood how blue-light orchestrates changes in LOV structure and function. Here we show that the dynamics, oligomerization and DNA-binding properties of the photocontrolled transcription factor EL222 are dependent on both the flavin redox state and thioadduct formation. In the dark, monomeric EL222 forms transient encounter complexes with DNA. Under illumination, two distinct lit states are sequentially generated, termed lit1 and lit2, that are both able to assemble into EL222:DNA (2:1) complexes. Our results reveal the coupling between flavin photochemistry (protonation and covalent linkage) and fold stability in EL222 and potentially other flavoproteins.
abstract_zh: 转录因子EL222的活性通过蛋白质-发色团加合物形成、结构域间动力学、寡聚化及蛋白质-DNA相互作用得以调控，所有这些过程均由黄素单核苷酸（FMN）辅因子的光激发触发。为获得EL222光循环的分子层面见解，我们采用了互补方法：大分子X射线晶体学（MX）、核磁共振（NMR）波谱学、光学光谱学（红外及紫外/可见光）、分子动力学/元动力学（MD/metaD）模拟，以及使用非天然氨基酸的蛋白质工程。对EL222在有和无蓝光背照条件下的晶体结构观察仅发现细微原子位移，这一结果通过NMR数据得到证实，表明二级结构和折叠紧凑性无重大变化。溶液中的动力学实验提供了两种不同EL222构象（lit1和lit2）的证据，这些构象在光照下依次被占据。这两种光激发态分别被归属为共价结合的N5质子化FMN形式和非共价结合的对苯二酚FMN形式。分子建模揭示了由三种FMN状态（氧化态、加合物态和还原态）产生的差异动力学和结构域分离时间。此外，虽然暗态主要呈单体形式，但两种光激发态均经历缓慢的单体-二聚体交换。通过红外差谱观察到的光诱导α-螺旋性丧失被归因于二聚体EL222物种。出乎意料的是，NMR显示所有三种EL222物种（暗态、lit1、lit2）均能在一定程度上与DNA结合，但仅在光照下才能获得高丰度的稳定复合物。总体而言，我们提出了一个精炼的EL222光激活模型，其中FMN氧化态的光诱导变化和硫代加合物的形成将群体平衡转向有利于自结合和DNA结合的开放构象。意义声明黄素结合的光-氧-电压（LOV）蛋白是高度进化的含发色团蛋白的突出例子，这些蛋白将光转化为细胞内的生化变化。然而，蓝光如何协调LOV结构和功能的变化尚不十分清楚。在此，我们表明光控转录因子EL222的动力学、寡聚化和DNA结合特性依赖于黄素氧化还原状态和硫代加合物形成。在暗态下，单体EL222与DNA形成瞬态遭遇复合物。在光照下，两种不同的光激发态依次生成，称为lit1和lit2，两者均能组装成EL222:DNA（2:1）复合物。我们的结果揭示了EL222中黄素光化学（质子化和共价连接）与折叠稳定性之间的耦合，并可能适用于其他黄素蛋白。
